name: Fieldset
description: A named native fieldset with shared description and validation relationships.

id.description: Stable native id used to derive supporting-region ids.

label.description: Fallback visible legend used when the legend slot is absent.

description.description: Fallback help text used when the description slot is absent.

error.description: Fallback validation message used when the error slot is absent.

invalid.description: Marks the group invalid even when no error content is rendered.

default.description: Trusted grouped form controls with derived accessibility metadata.

legend.description: Trusted visible legend content that takes precedence over label.

description.description: Trusted help content that takes precedence over description.

error.description: Trusted validation content that takes precedence over error.
